projects.title: AMI Maritime - Crew Manning
projects.description: A Philippine ship manning platform & unified Crew 201 portal connecting MARINA & STCW certified officers, marine engineers, and ratings with global fleets.

caseStudy.clientOrContext: AMI Maritime (Aegis Crew Manning) — Philippine Ship Manning & Crew Portal
caseStudy.themeLabel: Maritime Obsidian, Gold Crest & Interactive Ocean Mesh
caseStudy.executiveSummary: Engineered a modern Philippine ship manning web platform and unified Seafarer & Principal Crew Portal for a DMW-licensed, MLC 2006 compliant maritime agency—pairing 3D fleet visuals and GSAP motion with a 5-stage Crew 201 digital embarkation workflow.

typography.styleNote: Bold geometric display face for fleet command & rank headlines
High-legibility UI sans for Crew 201 forms & maritime compliance copy
Technical monospace for STCW stages, vessel divisions & document codes

challengesAndSolutions.title: 5-Stage Digital Crew 201 Embarkation
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Traditional manning applications relied on walk-in paper dossiers, fragmented PEME medical checks, and opaque mobilization timelines for seafarers and shipowners.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Structured a transparent 5-stage embarkation sequence covering digital Crew 201 intake, COC/COP & SIRB credential verification, principal interviews, clearance processing, and vessel sign-on.

challengesAndSolutions.title: Department-Aware Fleet & Rank Routing
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Deck officers, marine engineers, ETOs, and shipboard ratings across container, bulk, tanker, and offshore fleets needed tailored application paths without sifting through irrelevant openings.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built interactive Fleet Division cards and rank selectors (Master Mariner, Chief Engineer, ETO, Boatswain, Able Seaman) that pre-configure the 5-step seafarer application by department.

challengesAndSolutions.title: Unified Seafarer & Principal Portal
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Both shipping principals and deployed crew lacked a single reliable workspace to track document expiries, interviews, contracts, and upcoming vessel rotations.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Designed a unified dual-role Crew Portal with dark/light theme support, Three.js + GSAP editorial transitions, and clear MLC 2006 zero-placement-fee verification.

futureRoadmap.title: Automated MARINA & STCW Document Expiry Alerts
futureRoadmap.detail: Monitor SIRB, passport, PEME medical, and STCW certificate expiries automatically and trigger scheduled renewal reminders for officers and crewing staff.

futureRoadmap.title: AI Sea-Service Matrix & CV Parsing
futureRoadmap.detail: Extract vessel tonnage, engine kW ratings, and sea-service dates from uploaded seafarer CVs directly into standardized Crew 201 profiles.

projects.title: La Sistah - Dress Rental Studio
projects.description: A luxury couture dress rental studio & boutique e-commerce platform with live calendar booking, automated Gmail confirmations, and AI stylist assistance.

caseStudy.clientOrContext: La Sistah — Couture Dress Rental Studio & Boutique (General Santos City)
caseStudy.themeLabel: Haute Couture Petal Blush, Raspberry & Atelier Gilt
caseStudy.executiveSummary: Designed and engineered a full-stack luxury dress rental and boutique e-commerce platform housing 64 archival couture silhouettes and 31 shop pieces—complete with conflict-free 3-day calendar booking, automated Gmail confirmations, reservation tracking, and integrated stylist chat.

typography.styleNote: High-contrast couture editorial serif & italic display headlines
Refined geometric sans for catalog filtering, pricing & rental flow
Structured tabular numbering for look codes & booking trackers

challengesAndSolutions.title: Conflict-Free 3-Day Rental Calendar
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Manual DM and spreadsheet booking created double-booked gowns, unclear dry-cleaning turnaround buffers, and delayed availability replies.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built a live reservation engine (/api/rentals) that validates 3-day date windows per silhouette, issues unique tracking codes, and reflects real-time availability across 64 archival looks.

challengesAndSolutions.title: Editorial Luxury & Multi-Facet Discovery
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Standard e-commerce templates flattened the maison aesthetic and made navigating 64 rental gowns alongside 31 boutique purchase items cumbersome.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Crafted a lookbook pairing Cormorant Garamond editorial typography, gilt-arched cards, curated Styling Chapters, and instant filtering by silhouette, adult/kids sizing, status, and boutique shop.

challengesAndSolutions.title: Automated Gmail Receipts & Stylist Chat
challengesAndSolutions.problem: Clients booking gowns and private salon fittings expected immediate confirmation codes, tracking visibility, and rapid styling recommendations.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Integrated an automated Gmail confirmation pipeline (/api/gmail), self-service Reservation Tracker (/track), and an embedded stylist chat assistant (/api/chat) backed by customer and accounting APIs.

futureRoadmap.title: AI Silhouette Stylist & Fit Recommender
futureRoadmap.detail: Match shoppers to available couture gowns using event dress code, color mood, measurements, and real-time studio calendar slots.

futureRoadmap.title: Automated SMS Fitting & Return Reminders
futureRoadmap.detail: Trigger scheduled SMS and Gmail notifications for private salon fittings, courier dispatches, and post-event returns synced to /api/accounting.
